quote: GTA 6 has great gameplay mechanics. The driving feels responsive, the controls are intuitive, and exploring the open world is fun. But I ran into too many bugs, and I was more concerned by how much graphic violence and adult content there **** son is in jail, and I believe games like GTA influenced some of the choices he made. That experience shapes how I see this game. As much as I enjoyed the gameplay, I wouldn’t recommend it for kids.

author: anonymouser9021
quote: As a longtime Zelda fan, revisiting Ocarina of Time is always a reminder of why this game changed everything in 1998 and why its structure still works so well today. Loved the game! Hoping more old Zelda games come in the same structure.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
